## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run typecheck` is clean
- [ ] the suite nearest the change is green (`bash scripts/<suite>/run-all.sh`)
- [ ] `bun run verify` was run before requesting review, or the reason it was not is stated above
- [ ] one concern per commit, and each message says why
- [ ] the documentation that describes the changed behaviour was updated with it
